verdict.rationale: The CLI explicitly supports targeting multiple agents in one command (`-a claude-code -a opencode`), documents per-agent install paths (`./<agent>/skills/`), and lists Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode plus 70+ more as supported agents, with docs claiming 'build a skill once, use across any skills-compatible agent.' Community discussion focuses on leaderboard ranking fairness rather than disputing the cross-agent install mechanics. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that installs actually work identically across all four named agents, and clearer per-harness instruction differences beyond directory paths.
